params.1273:
The wall is too high to climb without aid. Click on the plank in your inventory to select it, then on the wall to construct a ramp.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: In your inventory, click on the plank to select it (or right-click and select 'Use').
params.1275: With the plank selected, click on the low wall to place it. Once you have placed the plank down, you will be able to climb the wall by clicking on it.
